component.name: Cellular Automata
component.summary: Conway's Game of Life and other Life-like cellular automata

description.p: A native desktop sandbox for Life-like cellular automata — Conway's Game of Life is just one of the 21 built-in rules, grouped by long-term behavior (stable/chaotic/explosive). Built with egui/eframe. Includes a pattern collection per ruleset (still lifes, oscillators, spaceships, guns, methuselahs), Golly RLE copy/paste, density-based starting configurations, a Draw/Pan/Eraser toolbox, Google Maps-style pan and zoom, and a minimap.
